evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a 2017 GX460 with the V8 and an automatic, silver over black, with tasteful mild accessories (aftermarket wheels, A/T tires, crossbars, hitch) visible in photos showing a clean, detailed interior and top-side engine bay. Everything else rests on seller prose: no VIN, title only claimed, 'full maintenance records' and annual Krown treatment asserted but not shown. Nothing mechanical is stated as wrong. A small red indicator lit in one cluster photo is ambiguous and needs a running-engine check. The decisive open items for this model are frame and underbody condition on a salt-belt car, SAI history, KDSS fitment and status, and coolant seepage, and none are evidenced. At $23,900 the ask is about 26% above the $19,013 fair-value mid. It has sat about 21 weeks after a $3,000 reduction, and a higher-mileage 2017 Premium sold for $17,750.
